statement.purpose: One large deep-navy sentence on mist with inline photo pills.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; split-layout and card-scale h2s step down to clamp(28px, 2.8vw, 40px)–clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 52px).

figure.purpose: Proof-grid values with a 16px/600 ink-soft label below.

button.purpose: Every primary pill action, in the display face.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State fades (160-260ms), draw-on-view strokes, nav underline.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Hover lifts, arrow nudges, card and tile tilts, pill widen, stage wake (700ms), success pop.

motion.name: draw-on-view
motion.purpose: Scribbles, ticks and proof icons draw when scrolled into view; armed only when motion is allowed and the figure is off-screen.

motion.name: route-ink
motion.purpose: Journey route inks with scroll progress (pivot at 60% of viewport); stages wake as it arrives.

motion.name: idle-loop
motion.purpose: Gentle idle animation: wiggle, bob, hop, turn, rise, swing, sway, twinkle, glow, flicker, fly.

motion.name: ticker
motion.value: translateX(-100%) 32s linear infinite; paused on hover/focus

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms; figures drawn; route --progress 1; all stages awake; plane at offset-distance 82%; ticker static and scrollable

narrative.overview:
BKG Global School is a navy-and-white school world, dressed in the school's own colours, where a pen is always at work. Lines draw themselves under headlines, icons draw themselves in the proof grid, and a dotted route inks itself down the page as a parent scrolls from Pre-KG to Class X. Small flat illustrations (blocks, books, flasks, compasses, caps, a paper plane, an atom, a marigold flower, a diya, a lit hostel at night, a trophy) live around the school's real photographs. They idle gently and never perform. The illustrations make it lively, the heavy grotesque headlines and plain sentences make it serious, and the blazer navy with crest gold keeps it from feeling either childish or corporate.

The page is airy on white, with mist bands, one full navy band for the SMILE framework, and deep navy at both ends: the announcement bar on top and the footer below. Everything has an outline. Photos, cards, the form, step numbers, letter tiles and every illustration share the same 2.5px deep-navy stroke, so photography and drawing read as one material. Depth comes from outlines, tilt, tape and overlap, never from shadows.

The system turns down the photo-hero-plus-three-cards template and the earlier rejected two-ink textbook look. Motion serves understanding: it guides the eye along the journey and never holds back information. With reduced motion everything is fully drawn and still.
keyCharacteristics: Navy and white as the school colours, with deep-navy outlines, mist and sky panels, crest gold for small faces and highlights, and tie red only as a spark inside drawings.
The official raster crest logo in the masthead. Never redraw it.
Bricolage Grotesque at 800 for headlines and Figtree for reading.
2.5px deep-navy outlines on every frame, card, tile and illustration, with 28px-rounded photo frames and 22px-rounded cards.
Flat illustrations with round caps that draw on view and idle gently.
Pill-shaped actions and tags, round step numbers, tilted letter tiles.
No shadows. Depth comes from outline, tilt, tape and overlap.

rules.name: The Crest Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears as a stroke, an illustration fill, a highlight a few pixels wide, or a small face of 56px or less (letter tiles, status tags, one pill button on a navy panel). Never use it for a section band, a large panel or the primary action. Gold text appears only on deep or navy grounds, never on white.

rules.name: The Tie Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a spark, not a colour role. Use it only as a small fill inside a drawing, and never for text, borders, buttons or errors.

rules.name: The Deep Outline Rule
rules.body: On light grounds, deep navy is the only outline colour. Every new figure, frame, tile or card on white or mist gets a deep-navy stroke, so drawings and photos belong to the same world.

rules.name: The Heavy Head Rule
rules.body: Set headings in Bricolage at 700 to 800 with negative tracking and text-wrap: balance. Body and labels are always Figtree.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No text is uppercased anywhere in the system. Labels stay small, bold and in sentence case.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Use no box-shadow or drop shadow anywhere. If an element needs lift, give it an outline, a tilt, tape or an overlap.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Borders come in three weights: 2.5px deep navy for frames, tiles and figures, 2px for interactive controls and tape, and 1.5px for dividers and small status tags.

dos: Do outline every photo frame, card, tile, medallion and illustration shape in 2.5px deep navy.
Do round photo frames and panels at 28px and cards at 22px, and shape every action, tag and choice as a 999px pill.
Do draw illustrations as flat shapes in navy, deep, sky, mist, gold and white, with round caps and joins.
Do use the official raster logo (public/images/bkg/logo.png) as the brand mark.
Do let lines draw on view (1.1s ease-out) and let figures idle gently. Use spring easing for hover.
Do render everything fully drawn and still under prefers-reduced-motion, and let tickers stop and scroll by hand.
Do set headings in Bricolage Grotesque at 700 to 800 with negative tracking, and body text in Figtree at 18px/1.6.
Do use a 3px gold outline for every focus state.
donts: Don't use box-shadow or drop shadows. Depth comes from outline, tilt, tape and overlap.
Don't use gold for a section band, a large panel, the primary action, or text on white.
Don't use tie red for text, borders, buttons or error states.
Don't redraw, recolour or rebuild the crest logo as SVG or type.
Don't add gradients, textures or detailed rendering to illustrations.
Don't uppercase labels or put small labels above headings.
Don't set body or label text in Bricolage, or headings in Figtree.
